description: This file sets up API route handlers for progress tracking in a learning platform, including endpoints for retrieving overall progress, module-specific progress, and tracking progress updates. It integrates middleware for authentication and references controller functions to handle business logic.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handler for retrieving overall progress, protected by authentication middleware.

methods.name: router.get('/module/:moduleId')
methods.description: Handler for retrieving progress for a specific module, protected by authentication middleware.

methods.name: router.post('/track')
methods.description: Handler for tracking and updating user progress, protected by authentication middleware.
